description: This file contains implementation of OS-related functions such as task creation, starting, sleeping, and termination, using POSIX threads for task management.

methods.name: int Os_CreateTask(OsTaskType * tcb,TaskEntryType entry,void * arg,int priority,const char * name)
methods.description: Initializes a task control block with task entry point, arguments, priority, and name.

methods.name: void * os_task_entry(void * arg)
methods.description: Internal static function serving as the thread entry point, executing the task's entry function.

methods.name: int Os_StartTask(OsTaskType * tcb)
methods.description: Creates and starts a new thread for the specified task control block.

methods.name: void Os_Sleep(uint32_t ms)
methods.description: Pauses the current task for a specified number of milliseconds.
